title: Forms Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 📋️forms plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms) to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14: move the owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, fold sibling variant files (🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs) into their own component folders, relocate any nested data/docs to owner root, and verify zero test-count drift. Mechanical retrofit only, no logic changes.
summary: Retrofitted 📋️forms to Shape V2 tree purity (TEMPLATE.md §14), purely mechanical, no logic changes. Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, updated Cargo.toml [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs", and prefixed all 36 #[path] strings inside it with ../../ (byte-diffed against git HEAD to confirm nothing else changed). Folded the two sibling variant files into their own component folders: 🦀️config.rs -> 🎚️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs -> 🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (both byte-identical moves, mod identifiers unchanged so no use-site edits needed). No nested data dirs or AGENTS.md/README.md were found in the tree (📚️examples/ was already correctly at the owner root pre-retrofit). Live cargo verification (check/clippy/test/wasm) is blocked workspace-wide by the documented pre-existing 📕️norm dangling-manifest issue in root Cargo.toml (not touched, not this plugin's bug) - substituted careful manual byte-diffing and #[path] mechanics verification instead, logged in 🧪️verification.txt. Final tree confirmed to contain only 🦀️component.rs files, 📦️packages, plain folders, and the allowed 📚️examples root data dir.
